Definition: Chotham, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Chotham is the name of two Israelites, one a son of Heber in Asher's line and one a father of two of David's mighty men. The name appears only in lists, with no story attached to either man. Both are remembered because their families and their sons were counted among God's people.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe names in the lists matter even when no story survives, because God counts people the world forgets.
